name: helloweb
description: Desktop orchestrator for running several web games side by side, each in an isolated browser session.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test

//allowScripts: npm 11+ blocks dependency install scripts. These two compile native code and are inert without an entry here. Approving the parent does NOT cover the transitive extract-file-icon - it needs its own line, which is easy to miss because the install still succeeds and only fails at runtime.
